fichas.title: Storage and shipping containers and pallets
fichas.summary: Storage containers consolidate goods into loading units to improve use of space and transport capacity and reduce handling. Standardised pallets, including the Europallet, can be exchanged within the European pallet pool without reloading; pallet types and accessories are illustrated.
uses: Exchange standardised pallets within the European pallet pool

fichas.title: Pallet racks and warehouse storage systems
fichas.summary: Pallet racks are modular systems made from channel and I-beam profiles. The page illustrates rack layouts for forklift operation and warehouse configurations, including a fully automated high-bay system with swivelling stacking cranes.
uses: Provide dense storage using pallet racks or automated high-bay systems

fichas.title: Flat shelving system
fichas.summary: Traditional industrial warehouse storage for small parts uses flat shelves. Shelving can be bolted or slot-in construction, with steel shelves, wire-mesh compartments, drawers or doors. The illustrated system is identified as Hofe.
